field_dictionary.fee_over_gross_x: protocol take divided by the crowd's entire gross edge
field_dictionary.maker_net_pct: the counterparty side of the same trades; it pays no taker fee, so this is the mirror of gross selection
field_dictionary.protocol_pct: taker fees collected by the venue over the same notional
field_dictionary.sum_pct: the three rows above; an identity, so it is zero
field_dictionary.taker_gross_selection_pct: how much the buying crowd beat its counterparties by, before fees — NOT anyone's final result
field_dictionary.taker_net_pct: what the buying side kept, as a share of its own buy notional (gross selection minus protocol fees)

caveats: This is a census of the top 500 markets by large-print notional — the venue's active core, not the venue. Long-tail markets are outside the frame.

The collector caps each market at 6,000 trades. The venue API returns newest-first, so a truncated market keeps its most recent 6,000 fills and loses older history — a recency skew on long-lived, high-frequency markets. Count in `sample.truncated_markets`.
Every rate is a per-window quantity. Two snapshots are only comparable through their windows.
how_to_replay.source: Polymarket public data-api /trades (tick tape) + gamma-api /markets (settlement prices and per-market fee schedules)
steps: Rank markets by whale-print notional and pull the full tick tape of the top 500.
Keep BUY legs only; the sell leg of the same fill is its mirror and would double-count.
For each trade: notional = px*size, gross = (settle-px)*size, fee = rate*px*(1-px)*size.
Settlement comes from the market's closed flag; unsettled markets are dropped, never marked to the current price. Markets without a readable fee rate are dropped too.
taker_net = gross - fee, maker_net = -gross, protocol = +fee. Sum over all trades, divide by total buy notional. The three rows sum to zero by construction.

method.fee_rate: per-market, read from Gamma feeSchedule; markets without a readable rate are dropped rather than defaulted
method.sample_frame: full tick tape of the top-N markets by whale-print notional — a census of large active markets, not of the venue
method.settlement: token_settlement — gated on the market's `closed` flag; unsettled markets are dropped, never marked to current price
method.truncation: the collector caps each market at 6,000 trades (earliest first); see the tape meta file for the truncated-market count

window.basis: trade timestamps of every reconciled fill
